metadata.scope: Phase 0 / U-004 third remediation and exact evidence gate

executiveSummary.text: All two Medium and three Low findings from the second review are closed under their original failure conditions. The immutable Git-object source binding, real target identity chain, Windows and manifest hardening, checklist split, and 32-of-32 parameter matrix are substantive. CHANGES_REQUESTED remains because evidence self-verification can leave a PASS manifest when a non-GateError I/O exception escapes. Two Low findings cover check-then-open reparse TOCTOU and unredacted MinIO response headers in identity artifacts. The final real-dependency 7-suite/33-testcase gate has not been executed.

topRisks.title: Non-GateError self-verification failure can leave PASS evidence
MinIO response headers bypass evidence secret validation

detailedFindings.title: Non-GateError self-verification failure can leave PASS evidence

evidence.relevantBehavior: A PASS manifest is persisted before self-verification and only GateError triggers downgrade, while ordinary file operations can raise OSError or PermissionError.

detailedFindings.failureScenario: A Windows file lock or concurrent deletion makes verification fail with a nonzero process exit while the already-persisted manifest remains PASS and is uploaded.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Finalize PASS atomically only after complete verification; ensure every non-success path leaves no PASS manifest.

detailedFindings.title: Evidence containment remains check-then-open

evidence.relevantBehavior: Path chains are checked for reparse points and later reopened by path without a no-follow anchored handle.

detailedFindings.failureScenario: A concurrently modified evidence parent is replaced after containment checks and before read or hashing, allowing the verifier to touch an out-of-root path before failing.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Use handle-anchored no-follow reads or validate an exclusively copied staging directory.

detailedFindings.title: MinIO response headers bypass evidence secret validation

evidence.relevantBehavior: Arbitrary clean-text Server and deploymentId values are archived without redaction while the manifest asserts containsSecrets=false.

detailedFindings.failureScenario: A proxy or non-standard target reflects credential-like metadata in a service header that is retained in the uploaded identity artifact.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Constrain the identity format, omit or allowlist Server, and scan or redact identity artifacts before declaring them secret-free.

safetyBoundary.gitMutations: no stage, commit, merge, push, or deploy
